sentence_stem: The article was rewritten several times
correct_completion: because the editor found several factual errors.
full_sentence: The article was rewritten several times because the editor found several factual errors.
acceptable_variants: since the editor spotted several mistakes.

options.text: and the editor was pleased with it.
options.why_wrong: This adds a reaction but gives no reason for the rewriting, so it does not complete a cause-and-effect link.

options.text: although it was published on time.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but the stem sets up no contrast to resolve, so the clause does not fit logically.

options.text: because the editor found several factual errors.
unless the author agreed to new changes.
options.why_wrong: 'Unless' introduces a condition that must be met, which does not explain why the article was rewritten in the past.

explanation: The stem describes an action, so the completion must give its cause. 'Because' introduces a reason. Learners often confuse the connectors that express reasons with those that express contrast, because a single word in their own language can cover both meanings.
translation: O artigo foi reescrito várias vezes porque o editor encontrou vários erros factuais.
